# Aura UI — AI 友好的 React 组件库

> 基于 React 18 + TypeScript + CSS Variables，支持亮/暗双模式主题

## 快速开始
npm install @aura/ui

## 组件列表
- Button: 按钮 (variant: default/primary/dashed/text/link, size: sm/md/lg)
- Typography: 排版 (Title/Text/Paragraph)
- Space: 间距
- Divider: 分割线
- Input: 输入框 (Password/Search/Group)
- Textarea: 文本域
- Select: 选择器
- Checkbox: 复选框 (CheckboxGroup)
- Radio: 单选框 (RadioGroup)
- Switch: 开关
- Alert: 警告
- Spin: 加载
- Tag: 标签 (Checkable/Group)
- Badge: 徽标
- Avatar: 头像 (Group)
- Tooltip: 文字提示 (8 placements, 3 triggers)
- Card: 卡片 (Header/Title/Body/Actions/Footer/Cover, 4 variants)
- Collapse: 折叠面板 (Item, accordion mode)
- Tabs: 标签页 (Tab, 3 variants: default/card/pill)
- Empty: 空状态 (Preset)
- Message: 全局消息 (success/error/warning/info/loading)
- Notification: 通知 (4 placements)
- Menu: 菜单 (Item/SubMenu/Group, 3 modes)
- Breadcrumb: 面包屑 (Item)
- Pagination: 分页 (showSizeChanger/showQuickJumper)
- Steps: 步骤条 (Step, 3 variants: default/dot/navigation)
- Dropdown: 下拉菜单 (4 placements)
- Slider: 滑动输入 (range, marks)
- Rate: 评分 (allowHalf, allowClear)
- Upload: 上传 (Dragger, 3 listTypes)
- Form: 表单 (Item, validation rules)
- Result: 结果页 (7 variants)
- Popconfirm: 气泡确认 (4 placements)
- Layout: 布局 (Header/Body/Sider/Footer)
- Flex: 弹性布局
- Scrollbar: 滚动条

## 文档
- 完整 API: /llms-full.txt
- 语义结构: /llms-semantic.md
